Home.heroSubheadline: SSZ Learn connects students with professional language schools and tutors. Study at your own pace, or bring your school online.
Home.audienceStudentDesc: Access structured language courses from professional schools and tutors. Track your progress, complete exercises, and study anywhere, anytime.
Home.audienceSchoolDesc: Create courses, manage students, and track their progress — all in one platform. Publish content, invite students, and grow your teaching.
Home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to learn and teach
Home.feature1Desc: Follow professionally crafted curricula with lessons, vocabulary, grammar, and interactive exercises.
Home.feature2Desc: See your improvement with detailed statistics, streaks, and learning history.
Home.feature3Desc: Norwegian, English, Ukrainian and more — all in one platform.
